lesson.menu_desc: Say who you are and get the keys, without your children doing it for you -- verb to be
lesson.subtitle: Lesson 1 -- The Rental Counter
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Carlos Henrique Rodrigues | Lesson 1 -- The Rental Counter
lesson.grammar_point: verb to be (I am, you are, it is: affirmative, negative and questions)

listenings.text: Hello, and welcome to Sunshine Car Rental at Miami International Airport. Our counter is on level three. Please have your reservation number, your passport and your driver's license ready. A credit card is necessary. Insurance is not in the online price. After the counter, your car is in the parking lot, next to the elevator. Thank you, and welcome to Florida.

Hi, I'm Paulo. I'm from Brazil, and I am sixty-two years old. I am in Orlando with my wife. At the rental counter, I am always a little nervous. But today the agent is very nice. She is patient, and her English is slow and clear. My English is simple, and that is okay. The car is small, but it is new. Now we are on the road.

extra_audio.text: Carlos is at Miami International Airport. He is at the rental counter. He says: I am Carlos, and I have a reservation. He gives his passport and his driver's license. He asks: Is insurance included? The car is in the parking lot, and he is happy.
